Begleitschlepper-Verbindung

The established secured line or method by which an escort tug is physically connected to a vessel, typically for controlling or assisting the ship during harbour or restricted water navigation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Begleitschlepper-Verbindung?

In this glossary, Begleitschlepper-Verbindung refers to: The established secured line or method by which an escort tug is physically connected to a vessel, typically for controlling or assisting the ship during harbour or restricted water navigation.

How is Begleitschlepper-Verbindung used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Schiff nähert sich der Mole, bestätigen Sie, dass die Begleitschlepper-Verbindung gesichert und für die Hafeneinfahrt bereit ist. Melden Sie Probleme an die VTS auf UKW Kanal sechzehn."

Definition

The established secured line or method by which an escort tug is physically connected to a vessel, typically for controlling or assisting the ship during harbour or restricted water navigation.

Operational example

Vessel approaching breakwater, confirm escort tug connection secured and ready for harbour entry. Report any issues to VTS on VHF channel one-six.
